section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the service of Israel in the final moments of exile is with self-sacrifice, a miracle within a miracle, leading to the division of the land by lot and the true and complete redemption.
section.t: And this is “You have given to those who fear You a banner to be raised high, because of truth, Selah,”
for the truth of Avraham is in a manner of Selah,
forever,
that even at the end of all worlds, in the generation of the heels of Moshiach,
and in this itself, in the last moments of the exile,
behold, the service of Israel is with self-sacrifice,
the aspect of a miracle within a miracle in the soul,
for not only do they have the matter of the horns,
but moreover,
they are in a manner of “the horns of the righteous shall be raised high”
(and as Rashi explains, that it refers to Israel, who are the praise of the Holy One, blessed be He,
the Righteous One of the world).
And through this, “May Your beloved ones be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me,”
for the salvations of the right hand in the time of exile are in a manner of “He turned back His right hand.”
And this is through the revelation of the aspect of a lot for each and every one,
“and you shall stand for your lot at the end of the days,”
the aspect of “You maintain my lot.”
And through this is done
(but by lot)
“he shall divide the land”
(and in the two versions in the manuscripts of the Maamarim 199,
“he shall divide” and “it shall be divided”),
the division of the land literally
(for nothing departs from its plain meaning),
and below ten handbreadths, in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our Righteous One,
for then there will be the conquest of the complete Land of Israel,
and afterwards the conquest of the land of the Kenite, the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,
and afterwards “the L-rd your G-d will expand your border,”
an inheritance without boundaries.
And since all this is done through the aspect of the lot, which is above time and space,
therefore there is no need at all for a length of time, but rather as the language of the Alter Rebbe 200,
“a day that is entirely long,” meaning that even at its beginning it is long,
for in a single moment the true and complete redemption comes with all its details and completeness,
until “the L-rd your G-d will expand your border,”
specifically through the L-rd 201
(in the manner of “You specifically maintain my lot”),
very soon with the coming of Moshiach our Righteous One,
that the Holy One, blessed be He, leads Israel with upright stature in the true and complete redemption,
and “He will raise the horn of His Moshiach” 202,
and these days will be turned to joy and gladness and good festivals 203,
speedily in our days.
